refined_requirement: Allow members to edit every project in their own workspace while preserving owner and admin access.

invariants.behavior: Owners and admins can edit projects.

impacts.evidence: The request explicitly grants workspace members edit access.

summary.prevention: Restrict access to the member's workspace and test denials.

decisions.choice: Members edit projects only in their own workspace.
decisions.rationale: This is the explicit selected scope.

criteria.criterion: Members edit own-workspace projects while outsiders remain denied.
